method: numpy-level M8 vs i8 comparison (GH#37462 patch core). pip pandas==1.1.3 has _ndarray=int64 (pre-regression), so monkey-patch cannot reproduce. base_commit stores _ndarray as datetime64[ns] after PR#37313; this measures the fundamental M8→i8 speedup that the patch exploits.
notes: Accurate end-to-end measurement requires cloning pandas at 4c8d66ecfe2b13607afd254443979b1ff842b6c1 and building from source, or using the Docker image. Apptainer blocked by unpriv.link on Lustre.
